items.content_text: A La Altura: Visionary Mexican Music 1977-1999 brings together 25 artists working across electronic, indigenous, ambient, jazz, minimalism and New Age music.

items.title: Volvox and Dominga launch new FLINTA*-focused club night ABOV
items.content_text: Erika, Shyboi and Hyperaktivist are among the bookings for launch events in Berlin and New York.

items.title: FKA twigs announced as Saffron's first official patron
items.content_text: The Eusexua artist will support the Bristol-founded non-profit's work expanding access to music technology for women, nonbinary and trans people.

items.title: Autechre announce support acts for upcoming tour
items.content_text: MDX, Space Afrika, Valentina Magaletti, Konx-om-Pax and more will join the Rochdale duo across their previously announced September and October dates.

items.title: DC party SEQUENCE unveils tenth anniversary reunion party
items.content_text: The underground techno collective will stage its first event in six years with Perc, Juana b2b Ron Jackson, Scotia, DJ Dubu and more.

items.title: Police called to Berlin club Weekend after guest alleges security threatened him with gun
items.content_text: A 22-year-old guest said a security member pointed a firearm at his head after removing him from the Alexanderplatz venue. Weekend denies the allegation.

items.title: Arca: Diva, Interrupted
items.content_text: One of experimental music's most cutting-edge producers is now one of this era's defining stars. Where does Arca go next? For our third summer cover story, Rachel Grace Almeida finds out.

items.title: Sound Metaphors Festival returns to Berghain next month
items.content_text: The three-day event will feature performances from Mohammad Reza Mortazavi, Alessandro Cortini, Z@p and more.

items.title: Sonny Fodera to donate £1 from every 2027 arena ticket to UK grassroots music
items.content_text: The contributions from his four March 2027 shows will go to LIVE Trust, which funds venues, artists and other parts of the UK grassroots sector.

items.title: Dark Entries to release two archival albums from 'Lou Reed of gay porn' J.D. Slater
items.content_text: Filling Your Silence and Elbow Deep In The Hoopla will be available on October 16th.

items.title: Watch a documentary on the corporate capture of UK festival Boomtown
items.content_text: Simon Doherty's short film asks "When the hyper-commodification of human joy and the perception of public safety butts heads with our privacy, where do we draw the line?"

items.title: Mix Of The Day: Ne/Re/A
items.content_text: White-hot, relentless techno.
